title: Greek-Sahidic alignment pilot benchmark (JAK-28)

excluded_from_training_stack: coptic-thomas-dilley (JAK-30; reconstruction target, not NT train)

lexical_baseline.algorithm: verse-level type co-occurrence Dice (once per type per verse) + mild positional prior; score restricted to gold-annotated left token ids

scoring.note: Every alignable left token gets a 1-best proposal (min_dice=0); only gold-annotated Sahidic left token ids enter the precision denominator so partial gold does not conflate coverage with accuracy. F1 is 0.0 when both denominators are nonzero and TP=0.

overall.notes: No pass/fail threshold. Denominators are predicted link count and gold link count after optional unit_id filter. Predictions restricted to gold-annotated left (Sahidic) token ids so partial gold does not conflate coverage with precision. Omission fixtures must not appear in these denominators. F1 is 0.0 when both denominators are nonzero and TP=0.

train.notes: No pass/fail threshold. Denominators are predicted link count and gold link count after optional unit_id filter. Predictions restricted to gold-annotated left (Sahidic) token ids so partial gold does not conflate coverage with precision. Omission fixtures must not appear in these denominators. F1 is 0.0 when both denominators are nonzero and TP=0.

eflomal.detail: eflomal import failed (ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'eflomal'). PyPI eflomal 2.0.0 requires compiling src/ via make; no wheel was available here. Lexical Dice baseline remains the deterministic offline path. Jake decision: whether to add a native eflomal toolchain pin later (still no LLM).

limitations: No numeric pass threshold - baseline only (PLAN.md Phase 2).
Whitespace tokenization is not morphology; Coptic groups stay fused.
Verse-level type Dice still over-generates co-occurrence; order is weak.
Human gold is a small sample; scoring uses annotated-left coverage only.
John 8:1-11 omission fixtures excluded from positive denominators.
Matthew 13:31-32 holdout scored only when present in gold fixtures.
Greek = NTVMR Vaticanus B* (GA 03 / docID 20003) only; no WH/SBLGNT mix.
eflomal unavailable without native build; not on default path.
Thomas Greek fragments (7/17/30/77) are outside this NT training stack.
